content: Hey! I'm your build agent — describe any UI piece (button, hero, pricing section, full page…) and I'll build it live in the canvas. What would you like to start with?

Hi again! The frosted button is all set in `components/` — primitive plus preview with sizes, variants, and states. Want a variant on it (e.g. pill-shaped, more glassy), or shall we build the next piece — maybe an input, card, or a hero section to sit it in?
